Compress

Compression turns pages into images, so text is no longer selectable. Only saved if it makes the file smaller.

Fonts

Uploaded fonts are embedded in the PDF. Built in: 3 standard fonts, Roboto and 38 more embedded fonts, including look-alikes for Times New Roman, Arial, Courier New, Calibri, Cambria and Georgia.

Convert (in your browser)

Text-based conversion: text, headings, tables and numbers are kept; images and complex layout are not. Scanned PDFs need OCR, which is not available without a server.

Security (in your browser)

Encrypts with AES. If you forget the password, the file cannot be recovered.
